study.title: Towards real-time weed detection and segmentation with lightweight CNN models on edge devices
study.short_title: Lightweight SS deployed on Jetson; MobileNetV4-Seg IoU 0.769, F1 0.869, 44 FPS

segmentation.domain: real-time site-specific weed detection/segmentation of Palmer Amaranth (Amaranthus palmeri) in corn and soybean fields from UAV RGB imagery (256x256), with lightweight models deployed on resource-constrained NVIDIA Jetson edge devices (Jetson Nano and Jetson Orin Nano)
models_tested: MobileNetV4-Seg (proposed: MobileNetV4-Conv-Small encoder + semantic segmentation head decoder, 1.93 M params)
segmentation.best_model: MobileNetV4-Seg on Jetson Orin Nano: IoU 69.9%/76.8%, F1 82.3%/86.9% (corn/soybean), Precision 80.9%/83.8%, Recall 83.7%/90.2%, 44 FPS at 256x256

dataset.name: UAV RGB images of Palmer Amaranth: corn (Phantom 4 RTK, Carleton NE, July 2021; 5472x3648) and soybean (Matrice 300 RTK + Zenmuse P1, Clay Center NE, July 2022; 8192x5460), split into sub-images and resized to 256x256
dataset.note: Images used for the proposed MobileNetV4-Seg SS model: 443 corn sub-images (390 train / 10 val / 43 test) and 353 soybean sub-images (310 / 10 / 33); DeepLabv3+ SS used 120 sub-images per crop (100/10/10). Soybean GSD 0.06 cm/px at 5 m AGL; corn GSD 0.27 cm/px at 10 m AGL. Best accuracy achieved on the soybean dataset (higher resolution). 256x256 resized input used for all deployed models.

segmentation.backbone: MobileNetV4-Conv-Small (MobileNetV4-Seg); MobileNetV3 in the lightweight DeepLabv3+/SSD variants

mIoU.quote: For soybean, it achieved 76.8 % IoU, 83.8 % precision, 90.2 % recall, and an 86.9 % F1 score.
mIoU.section: 3.2. Performance comparison of lightweight OD and SS models on edge devices / Table 5
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary weed/background segmentation; IoU reported per dataset (corn 69.9%, soybean 76.8%) for MobileNetV4-Seg on Jetson Orin Nano. Best across datasets (soybean) recorded. For binary segmentation this class IoU approximates mean IoU.

mPA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy not reported (paper reports IoU, Precision, Recall, F1 per Section 2.5 S5).

F1.quote: For soybean, it achieved 76.8 % IoU, 83.8 % precision, 90.2 % recall, and an 86.9 % F1 score.
F1.section: 3.2. Performance comparison of lightweight OD and SS models on edge devices / Table 5
F1.ambiguity: F1 of 86.9% is the best across datasets (MobileNetV4-Seg, soybean; corn F1 82.3%).

Dice.ambiguity: Dice not reported explicitly (F1 score reported, which for binary segmentation equals the Dice coefficient).

weed_F1.ambiguity: F1 is reported for the weed/background binary segmentation task, not as a per-class crop-vs-weed breakdown (no crop_F1 counterpart reported).

crop_F1.ambiguity: No per-crop-class F1 reported (binary weed/background task).

edge.device: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (best SS model, MobileNetV4-Seg); NVIDIA Jetson Nano (lightweight DeepLabv3+ / SSD)
edge.framework: PyTorch (Jetson Orin Nano: torch 1.10.0 / torchvision 0.11.3 / CUDA 10.2; Jetson Nano: torch 2.4.1 / torchvision 0.19.1 / CUDA 11.4); no TensorRT/quantization used

fps.quote: The proposed MobileNetV4-Seg SS model achieved real-time (44 FPS) inference speed on Jetson Orin Nano
fps.ambiguity: Model-only inference speed (time to process one image through the model); excludes image storage load, model loading time and camera acquisition. DeepLabv3+ (MobileNetV3) reached only 10 FPS on Jetson Nano.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Latency not reported; throughput given in FPS only.

power_w.ambiguity: Jetson Nano was selected for low power consumption (472 GFLOPS, 250 g) but device power draw was not measured/reported.

params_M.quote: our developed model has only 1.93 million parameters

gflops.ambiguity: Model GFLOPS not reported (device capabilities cited: Jetson Nano 472 GFLOPS, Jetson Orin Nano 1280 GFLOPS FP32).

issues: Binary weed/background segmentation; metrics are for the single weed class per dataset, best (soybean) recorded for mIoU/F1.
Small test sets (43 and 33 sub-images) and limited field/lighting variation acknowledged by the authors.
Inference speeds are model-only (exclude storage load, model loading, camera acquisition); power consumption not measured.
FP32 deployment precision inferred from PyTorch on the Jetson GPUs (no quantization/TensorRT applied) - not stated explicitly.
